note: Pins for the server side of DESIGN.md 11.2 (Fabric 1.21.1 + Lithium + Carpet + harness mod) and the pregeneration tool. Pinned on 2026-10-19 from check-mods on the owner's PC (instance inst-0, first start and stop). check-mods fails on another Java and on any missing, changed or extra jar. It reports NOT FROZEN until the harness mod exists (M2), by design. Changing a pinned value is a change of the frozen config: measure again (DESIGN.md 11.2).

server_jar.source: Mojang's 1.21.1 server jar, as the Fabric launcher caches and runs it. The launcher keeps it in .fabric/server/1.21.1-server.jar (and a remapped copy in versions/1.21.1/server-1.21.1.jar, not pinned). Same file as https://piston-data.mojang.com/v1/objects/59353fb40c36d304f2035d51e7d6e6baa98dc05c/server.jar (version JSON https://piston-meta.mojang.com/v1/packages/499680d659b7a0ccb2fa9a809c345c5baf2ace7d/1.21.1.json); the data generator runs on a copy of that file
